scope: ui.hub.skills.*: download, unpull, unpull_title, unpull_body, unpull_failed, subscribe_failed, local_path, published_by, not_downloaded, subscribed_absent, pulled, manual, detached (13 keys) audited against English ui.hub.json

findings.note: "سبسکرائب" is the imperative/verb used on the subscribe button (ui.hub.subscriptions.subscribe "سبسکرائب کریں"), so the badge reads "Subscribe — not installed" rather than a state. The noun everywhere else is "سبسکرپشن" (unpull_body, subscribe_failed, manual). Glossary drift: سبسکرائب vs سبسکرپشن.
Same imperative-as-state defect: the label reads "Download — Subscribe". Use the noun "سبسکرپشن" with the copula, as detached does ("ربط ہے — نقل نہیں").
